queue_stage_note: 'screen' is this job's place in the night QUEUE. Its STAGE CONTRACT stamp is `pnl`, because it reads the day decision contract — the latest artefact in the chain — and no stage may read one produced by a later one.
question: Murat, 2026-09-21: every night, find the largest market moves AEGIS did NOT capture, and for each ask whether the information was observable beforehand. Then make that the ONE paid question of the night, asked of BOTH readers on the SAME cases, so the paid model has to earn its cost.

paid_leg_gate.why_env_not_flag: scripts.night_factory launches every job with NO per-job CLI arguments, so a paid leg switched only by --backend can never run in the night queue

cost_cap.why_two: the soft stop is where this job stops asking; the hard cap is the _RunCap backstop for billing that lands after the last read. One number would be either too tight to finish or too loose to bind
